payload.name: chucho — Book Direct
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find vacation rentals, holiday homes, villas, and places to stay with chucho. Search by destination, guest count, bedrooms, and amenities; explore photos and property details; then follow the host’s booking link.

Same property. Same host. Fewer middlemen. Booking directly can reduce intermediary fees, helping guests save and hosts keep more of what they earn.

Search the available catalog in English or Spanish. Where supported, check host availability and prices for your dates or explore a clearly labeled sample stay. Some homes remain unchecked; prices may exclude fees or taxes. Confirm final availability, prices and booking terms with the host.

For participating hosts, prepare a custom booking enquiry, review the details and submit only after your approval. Enquiries do not confirm availability or create a booking.
payload.longDescription:
通过chucho查找度假租赁、假期房屋、别墅和住宿地点。按目的地、入住人数、卧室数量和设施搜索；浏览照片和房源详情；然后点击房东的预订链接。

同一房源。同一房东。减少中间商。直接预订可降低中介费用，帮助客人节省开支，让房东获得更多收益。

以英文或西班牙文搜索可用房源目录。在支持的地区，可查看房东在您指定日期的可用性和价格，或浏览明确标注的示例住宿。部分房源未实时更新；价格可能不包含费用或税费。请与房东确认最终可用性、价格和预订条款。

对于参与的房东，需先填写自定义预订咨询表，审核详情并在确认批准后提交。咨询内容不会确认房源可用性或生成预订。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Vacation rental search, Property photos and details, Host availability and stay prices where supported, Host booking links, Guest-approved booking enquiries

payload.name: Gjirafa eSIM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
See eSIM data plans for your trip, for countries, regions like Europe or the Balkans, or worldwide.

Ask in your own words, for example "I need mobile data in Germany" or "data plan for a week in Europe". Gjirafa eSIM shows each plan like the Gjirafa website does: data amount, validity, price and the most popular plan, with regional plans showing how many countries they cover. Open the full view to see every plan for the destination and filter by data, unlimited or validity. Open Gjirafa eSIM from the sidebar to search for a destination or pick a popular one, with the price per day.

Not sure your phone works with eSIM? Ask "does my iPhone 13 support eSIM?" and Gjirafa eSIM checks it against its list of supported phones, tablets and watches. You can also ask what travellers say about a destination's eSIMs and read its FAQ.

If your eSIM doesn't connect, is stuck on Activating or you're not sure how to install it, ask: you get the Gjirafa eSIM app's step-by-step troubleshooting guide (in 11 languages) and the installation guide for iPhone and Android. Questions such as "can I keep WhatsApp on my number?" or "can I share the data with my laptop?" are answered from Gjirafa's FAQ.

Connect your Gjirafa account to ask about the eSIMs you already have: "show my eSIM", "how much data do I have left?" or "when does my eSIM expire?". You see the data used and the days left for each eSIM and its packages, like in the Gjirafa eSIM app. You can rename an eSIM, see the eSIMs you gifted and remove a gift you never paid for, and choose which emails and SMS Gjirafa Travel sends you.

Every plan links to Gjirafa Travel, where you can see all plans for the destination, buy your eSIM, install it and top it up. Plans can be browsed in 16 languages; the views of your own eSIMs are in English, Albanian and German.
payload.longDescription:
查看适用于您旅行目的地的数据计划，包括德国、欧洲或巴尔干半岛等国家/地区，或全球范围的数据计划。

用您自己的话提问，例如「我需要德国的移动数据」或「欧洲一周的数据计划」。
Gjirafa eSIM的展示方式与官网一致：显示数据量、有效期、价格以及最受欢迎的数据计划，区域套餐会显示覆盖国家数量。
点击进入完整视图可查看目的地所有数据计划，并按数据量、无限流量或有效期进行筛选。
从侧边栏打开Gjirafa eSIM搜索目的地或选择热门套餐，显示每日价格。

不确定您的手机是否支持eSIM？
提问「我的iPhone 13支持eSIM吗？」，Gjirafa eSIM会根据支持设备列表（包括手机、平板和手表）进行验证。
您还可以查看旅行者对目的地eSIM的评价及常见问题解答。

如果eSIM无法连接、一直处于「激活中」状态或不确定如何安装，提问即可获得Gjirafa eSIM应用的逐步故障排除指南（支持11种语言）及iPhone和安卓的安装指南。
关于「我能否在原有号码上保留WhatsApp？」或「能否与笔记本电脑共享数据？」等问题，均可从Gjirafa常见问题解答中获得答案。

将您的Gjirafa账户连接以查看已有的eSIM：「显示我的eSIM」、「我的eSIM还剩多少数据？」或「我的eSIM何时过期？」。
您将看到每个eSIM及其套餐的数据使用情况和剩余天数，效果与Gjirafa eSIM应用一致。
您可以重命名eSIM、查看赠送的eSIM并取消未付款的赠送记录，还可选择接收Gjirafa Travel的哪些邮件和短信。

每个套餐均链接至Gjirafa Travel，您可查看目的地所有套餐、购买eSIM、安装并充值。
套餐支持16种语言浏览；您的eSIM视图支持英语、阿尔巴尼亚语和德语。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find eSIM data plans for a country, a region or worldwide, Compare data amount, validity and price, and filter every plan in the full view, Check whether a phone, tablet or watch supports eSIM, Step-by-step help when an eSIM doesn't connect, from the Gjirafa eSIM app's troubleshooting guide, Answer how eSIMs work: installing, keeping your number and WhatsApp, hotspot, gifts, Read a destination's eSIM FAQ and travellers' reviews, Show your eSIMs with data used and days left (Gjirafa account), Show an eSIM's packages: data used, validity and expiry, Rename your eSIMs, See the eSIMs you gifted and remove unpaid gifts, Show your Travel Credits balance, tier and history, Choose which emails and SMS Gjirafa Travel sends you, Open the eSIM picker and your eSIMs in the sidebar

payload.name: Adónde
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Adónde turns a conversation into a real trip. Say where and when, and it builds each day from bookable tours, sights, food and stays in a sensible order, with honest schedules that respect opening days and tour run times. Ask for hotels, flights or tours and get live prices; each result opens that exact hotel, fare or tour in the Adónde app or on the web, where booking happens. Ask for the nearest stays to a landmark, compare fares for a return trip, or find what is actually running on a given date. Connect an Adónde account, or just start and keep the trip by email with a sign-in link. Nothing is booked or paid for inside ChatGPT: checkout is external, on getadonde.com.
payload.longDescription: Adónde将对话转化为真实的旅行。说出目的地和时间，它会根据可预订的旅游项目、景点、餐饮和住宿，按合理顺序安排每一天，行程安排诚实可靠，尊重开放日和旅游运行时间。请求酒店、航班或旅游项目，获取实时价格；每个结果会直接打开Adónde应用或网页中的具体酒店、票价或旅游项目，完成预订。请求某个地标附近的住宿，对比往返航班价格，或查找特定日期实际运行的项目。连接Adónde账户，或通过邮件开始并保留行程，使用登录链接。在ChatGPT内部不会进行任何预订或支付：结账为外部流程，位于getadonde.com。

payload.name: Minerva Weekend
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Two days. So many possibilities. A long lunch somewhere lovely. A little adventure with the kids. A night in a hotel you won’t want to leave. Tell Minerva where you’re starting and what sounds good — anywhere in the world. Explore a few ideas in your conversation, choose your favourite and ask for its detailed route when you want it. Save the plans you love and find them again in chat. There’s always another weekend.
payload.longDescription:
两天时间。无限可能。
在某个美丽的地方享用漫长的午餐。
和孩子们来场小冒险。
入住一家让你舍不得离开的酒店。
告诉Minerva你从哪里出发，以及你想去的地方——全球任何地点都可以。
在对话中探索几个想法，选择你最喜欢的，并在需要时请求详细路线。
保存你喜爱的计划，随时在聊天中找到它们。
总会有另一个周末。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Compare weekend ideas, Check places and routes, Save private plans

payload.name: NYC RSVPs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
NYC RSVPs tells you exactly when reservations open at about 70 of New York City's hardest-to-book restaurants, such as Carbone, Don Angie, Torrisi, Via Carota, and 4 Charles Prime Rib.

Each restaurant releases tables on its own schedule: a set number of days ahead, a calendar month ahead, on the 1st of the month, or twice a month. Tell ChatGPT the restaurant and the night you want, and NYC RSVPs gives the exact release time in New York time, whether booking is already open, and the booking platform (Resy, OpenTable, Tock, SevenRooms, and others).

Compare up to three restaurants for a date in a compact card, or browse up to six by cuisine or neighborhood to see how far ahead each one books. Tap Book when booking is open, or Remind me to ask ChatGPT for a reminder before tables are released.

NYC RSVPs does not book tables, hold reservations, or take payments, and it does not need an account. Release rules come from each restaurant's published policy and can change.
payload.longDescription:
NYC RSVPs会准确告知您约70家纽约最难预订的餐厅的开放时间，包括Carbone、Don Angie、Torrisi、Via Carota和4 Charles Prime Rib等餐厅。

每家餐厅都会按照自己的时间表释放餐桌：提前若干天、提前一个月、每月1号或每月两次。
告诉ChatGPT您想预订的餐厅和日期，NYC RSVPs将提供纽约时间的具体释放时间，说明预订是否已开放，并告知预订平台（包括Resy、OpenTable、Tock、SevenRooms等）。

通过紧凑卡片对比最多三家餐厅，或按菜系/区域浏览最多六家餐厅，查看每家餐厅的最早可订时间。
当预订开放时点击「预订」，或点击「提醒我」让ChatGPT在餐桌开放前提醒您。

NYC RSVPs不负责实际预订、保留座位或收取费用，且无需账户。
具体开放规则依据各餐厅官方政策，可能随时调整。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find tracked NYC restaurants by name, cuisine, neighborhood, or booking platform, Calculate the exact time reservations open for a dining date, in New York time, Show restaurants in a card: exact opening times for a date, or each release rule when browsing, Prepare reminder details so ChatGPT can set a reminder before tables open

payload.name: Howdy Apartments
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Howdy! Help Texas A&M graduates, former students and families compare Dallas, Houston and Austin neighborhoods, read approved Aggie apartment answers and guides, and find apartments by budget. Ask for the exact office and days in the office before commute recommendations. Stored starting rents are not live quotes or availability. Read-only: does not book tours, process payments, submit applications or access customer records. Not officially endorsed by Texas A&M University.
payload.longDescription:
哈喽！
帮助德州农工大学毕业生、校友及家庭比较达拉斯、休斯顿和奥斯汀的社区，阅读经批准的阿吉斯公寓解答和指南，并根据预算寻找公寓。
在获取通勤建议前，请确认具体的办公地点及办公日。
存储的起始租金并非实时报价或可用性。
只读模式：不提供预约看房、处理付款、提交申请或访问客户记录。
未得到德州农工大学的官方认可。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find apartments, Open search links, Search approved knowledge, Read guides

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search, compare, and discover international travel eSIM data packages for over 190 countries. Check local, regional, and global cellular coverage, compare data allowances, and get instant connectivity details for seamless worldwide travel.
payload.longDescription: 搜索、比较并发现覆盖190多个国家的国际旅行eSIM数据套餐。查看本地、区域和全球移动网络覆盖，比较数据配额，并获取即时连接详情，实现无缝全球旅行。

information.label: Capabilities
